Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its
entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 General Information
 We are seeking a talented Software DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic team and develop next-generation software solutions for Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs). As a Software DevOps Engineer you will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable cloud infrastructures and developing CI/CT/CD Pipelines for Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs). You will contribute to the development of state-of-the-art products for hybrid/full-electric vehicles.
You will work in a virtual global team, and you will be responsible for deploying solutions together with colleagues abroad and tool suppliers.
This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer with strong analytical skills, a passion for automation, and the ability to take ownership of mission-critical services.
 Your Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD/CD pipelines for projects.
Deploy and maintain SW Build Platform and build environment on cloud based Digital Workbench 
Building and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) for vehicle software
Implement and roll-out virtualization solutions for Embedded SW - virtual ECU, digital twin;
Manage and optimize deployment: build agents, Jenkins servers, virtualization infrastructure
Automate deployment processes and system configurations for in-vehicle software.
Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability, good performance and reliability of virtual infrastructure
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate software components seamlessly
Fixing any bugs occurring in the build tool chain and efficient troubleshooting of any eventual problems;
Benchmarking and market investigation.
Work proactively to implement and continuously improve tools, process and methods
 Your Qualifications
University degree Computer Science, Engineering, or related field;
3+ years of experience in DevOps or related roles, preferably in the automotive domain.
Experience in Continuous Integration / Continuous Testing / Continuous delivery practices Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Github actions etc.).
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and operating systems: Windows, Linux.
Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible).
Familiarity with automotive software standards and protocols (AUTOSAR, CAN, etc.).
Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Bash, Perl).
Understanding of software-defined vehicle architecture and in-vehicle networking.
Deep understanding of build processes, build tools and HW virtualization solutions e.g. Synopsis, vVirtual target;
Knowledge of config management systems: Git, GitHub, Gerrit, Artifactory;
Attention to detail, accuracy and strong analytical skills;
Fluent English language skills - spoken and written;
Eager to learn new things and to investigate for solutions;
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you.
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind.
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library.
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best.
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and through referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow.
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday.
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we're committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us.
Meal Tickets: we're happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable.
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
